netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lin n1 n2
NMOS M1 n2 n1 VSS VSS
NMOS M2 n3 VDD n2 VSS
L Ld VDD n3
C Ct n3 n4
C Cout n4 VOUT1
rationale: The previous topology lacks sufficient input matching and stability margin, as evidenced by the severely negative normalized margin in S11 (-0.698), which is the binding constraint. The current design uses only a single NMOS in a common-source configuration with no input inductor or matching network, resulting in poor impedance matching at 3.5 GHz. To improve S11, inserting a series inductor at the input (between VIN1 and the gate of M1) enables resonant matching to 50Ω, enhancing input return loss while preserving gain and noise figure. This is critical for narrowband 3.5 GHz applications where input match is paramount. The inductor also provides a low-impedance path at the operating frequency, improving stability and reducing reflection. This edit directly targets the worst metric without affecting other performance areas, which are already within spec.
